item.title: Retired Holyoke, MA, Firefighter Snared in Drug Ring Probe
item.description: The 28-year veteran Holyoke firefighter reportedly sold balls of cocaine to an undercover officer.

item.title: Job Posting: Fire Lieutenant - Logistics - Hilton Head Island, SC
item.description: Hilton Head Island is seeking an experience fire lieutenant to manage the Fire & Rescue agency's logistics functions.

item.description: Firefighters found heavy fire showing when they responded to the Long Island house early Wednesday morning.

item.title: Modernizing Fire Station Alerting
item.description: Numerous suppliers provide systems that have color-changing lights, ramping audible tones, and text-to-speech readouts, among other tools, to provide means to minimize negative mental and physical effects.

item.title: South Greensburg, PA, Fire Chief Accused of $178K Theft from Department
item.description: The fire chief used South Greensburg Volunteer Fire Department money to make personal purchases, court records show.

item.title: Volunteer Fire Company Balking Unified Command Shut Down in Norwich, CT
item.description: "We want to retain our autonomy...We run our district," Yantic Fire Chief Bobby Allen said after the city suspended the 179-year-old company.

item.title: At House Fire, White Level, NC, Firefighter Collapses, Dies
item.description: White Level Firefighter/Safety Officer Dale Malone, 66, died after suffering a medical emergency in a department vehicle.

item.title: Oswego County, NY, Fire Chiefs Rescue Couple who Ran into Burning House to Save Dog
item.description: Ringgold and Richland fire chiefs, who made the rescues, said the dog escaped and is OK.

item.title: Water Main Break Damages Elrama, PA, Fire Rigs, Station; Briefly Traps Crew
item.description: Firefighters briefly trapped in a back room at the Elrama firehouse linked arms and waded through knee-deep water to escape.
